title: LaRecipe page frontmatter
description: The YAML at the top of a page: configuration for that page only. Keys under meta reach the UI as page meta. Other keys LaRecipe does not know are allowed but never sent to readers.

title.description: Required unless the first # heading gives it.

description.description: One sentence. Used in llms.txt, meta tags, search snippets and list_pages.

icon.description: A Lucide icon name for navigation.

sources.description: Globs of the code this page documents, for drift detection.

badge.description: A label next to the title in navigation: "New", or { label, tone }.

since.description: The version that introduced the feature.

hidden.description: Routable but not listed in the navigation.

noindex.description: Asks search engines not to index the page.

visibility.description: private pages need the viewLarecipe gate, on every surface.

inserts.description: Opt out of site-wide insert points: { article.after: false }, or false for all.

type.description: Reserved: openapi pages arrive in a later 3.x release.

meta.description: Values for your own components, which read them as page.meta. The only frontmatter readers receive beyond the keys above.
